description: A calm, platform-neutral CRM launch check for owners and revenue leaders.

defaultPrompt: Run a calm CRM Launch Check with me, one question at a time.
Help me clarify what our new CRM must make less painful.
Review my CRM launch check and suggest the next useful action.
interface.longDescription: Run a short, practical CRM Launch Check. The skill helps you name the problem, users, minimum-use rule, unanswered decisions, and proof of readiness, then leaves one local file and a sensible next action. It advises only: it never logs into or changes your CRM.
interface.shortDescription: Clarify a CRM launch before setup choices multiply.

name: crm-launch-operator-lite
